title: Scriptura Knowledge Graph Edge
description: A typed graph edge. Normative source: BKB-DATA-001 section 6.5 and ADR-0007. Every edge carries a layer and provenance. A link proposed by a discovery strategy is always ai_hypothesis.

relation.description: Drawn from a registered vocabulary. An unregistered relation is rejected.

non_authoritative.description: Always true where layer is ai_hypothesis.
